nome: Estensioni locali della parte del discorso
funzione: The values of the first position of the tag that the AGDT inventory does not document but that a resource declares as its own convention. They count as a linguistic category: the records that carry them are words, and the syntactic relation has no say on them.
usata_da: no part of the program reads this file: the value b is written directly in the code (units._LOCAL_POS and the check pedalion-b-pos); the file documents it
fonte: Pedalion README for b. The value z does not appear in it, because it marks a technical token and not a category of words, and units.is_technical_record intercepts it first. There is no per-resource profile mechanism: the list is fixed, and this line says so.

b.nota: The documentation speaks of a correspondence “in most cases” and therefore does not provide a one-to-one equivalence: no automatic conversion is proposed.
